request.prompt:
Create ORIGINAL-BASED animation source art of the EXACT blue crystalline golem in the supplied references, preserving its pointed crystal head, pale blue eyes, heavy faceted shoulder clusters, V chest, long bulky crystal fists, stout articulated thighs/calves and flat feet. Same cobalt/sapphire and icy-white crystalline model, same proportions and painted2D isometric RPG camera. Every head, shoulder, torso, arm, hand, pelvis, knee and foot remains physically attached with solid blue joint bridges. No new character, weapon, armor, hair, detached fragments, sparkles, smoke, floor or shadow. Preserve all original crystals on the body. REAL transparent alpha outside each whole figure. Never crop a spike, fist, toe or lying body. Clear spacious gutters; no neighboring-pose pixels inside any figure's rectangle. Constant physical model scale (falling body becomes wider naturally, do not shrink it). Independent views and genuinely different whole-body joint poses, not image rotation/mirroring/scaling.
EXACTLY12 complete figures in FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, very spacious wide landscape. Columns face W/left profile, NW/back-left, N/back, NE/back-right. True rear/back anatomy in the rear directions, no frontal eyes or chest pasted onto the back. Rows are three sequential stages of a HEAVY CONNECTED COLLAPSE. Row1: from the normal stance knees buckle deeply, hips descend and torso bows, arms still physically joined, one large fist bracing toward the ground. Row2: knees/hip touch down, weight tips naturally onto the bracing forearm, head/shoulders lower together, the other connected arm follows. Row3: fully dead crystal golem lying low on its side/front with hips/torso/head settled on the same ground and both arms/legs attached, blue core dim but body fully visible and opaque. Anatomically clear fall from standing into grounded corpse, no pile of loose rocks. No upright recovery in the final row. All12 poses complete, nonoverlapping with large clear transparent margins.
